entities.name: Sand Warriors
entities.description: Dominarian creatures made of sand, modeled after Hazezon and controlled by him.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Dominarian ruler who summons the Sand Warriors with a two-faced-head stick and magical verses.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Character in the Armada comic who was brought to Hazezon by the Sand Warriors.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Companion of Jedit in the Armada comic; described the Sand Warriors as impatient.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Sand Warriors exist.

events.summary: Hazezon summons Sand Warriors with a stick, twirling it while reciting verses ending 'Stand, sons of the sand!'
events.quote: He summons them using a short stick topped by a two-faced head

events.summary: In the Armada comic, after Jedit's monox died the Sand Warriors surrounded Jedit and Johan and brought them to Hazezon by desert ray.
events.quote: After Jedit 's monox died, the Sand Warriors surrounded them

relations.quote: Sand Warriors are Dominarian creatures controlled by Hazezon Tamar
